{{Top|leg}}
'''House Brentioch''' was a noble house on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. Its [[Seneschal/Legends|seneschal]] was [[Sival Brentioch]], who disguised himself as an errand boy for the house in order to assist his friend [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] of [[House Kallea]].
